body.name: Explicit nonzero transverse prior
body.construction: Represent \(\alpha_n=n^{-1/3}\) by the square-free polynomial \(nX^3-1\) and its rational isolating interval. For each \(\sigma=(\sigma_x,\sigma_h)\in\{-,+\}^2\), put \(Q_\sigma=\{(x,h):0\le\sigma_xx\le T,\ 0\le\sigma_hh\le\varepsilon\}\) and, for every \(t\in\{0,1\}^3\), \[p_{n,x,h,t}^\dagger=p_{0,t}^\dagger+\alpha_na_{\sigma,t}(x,h),\qquad a_{\sigma,t}(x,h)=|x|\lambda_{v,t}^{\sigma_x}+|h|\lambda_{d,t}^{\sigma_h}-(3|x|+2|h|)p_{0,t}^\dagger.\] Draw \(X^\dagger\) with density \(w_T\), draw \(H^\dagger\) independently with density \(\rho_\varepsilon\), draw \(m\sim\operatorname{Multinomial}(n,p_{n,X^\dagger,H^\dagger}^\dagger)\), and draw a labeled schedule uniformly within its response-count orbit. The sum of the four exact cell integrals defines \(\nu_{n,\varepsilon,T}^\dagger\) in the ordered field \(\mathbb Q(\alpha_n)\).
